company.name: Harmonic
company.shortDescription: Harmonic is an artificial intelligence lab that develops mathematical reasoning engine designed to tackle complex mathematical problems.
company.description: Harmonic builds an AI-driven mathematical reasoning engine that aims to bring “mathematical superintelligence” to theorem proving, software verification, and education. The platform integrates reinforcement learning and formal methods to support development of tools that can reason about mathematical concepts and verify correctness in safety-critical systems. Harmonic offers software components and AI research infrastructure to translate research into usable applications, including mobile and web products.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven engine designed to solve complex mathematical problems with verifiable correctness and interpretability.
productsAndServices.name: Mathematical Reasoning Engine
